description: Mississauga’s Development Pipeline uses active development applications and building permits to describe city growth. This member covers applications and keeps only the most recent application where several refer to the same development. Its CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML descriptors represent one resource. The description states a snapshot at the impossible date June 31, 2024; the native end is 19 June 2024. A geo_span field says Oakville while the owner and exact original portal identify Mississauga. These conflicts are preserved. References to permit data from 2014 to June 2024 describe related pipeline context, not a claim that this application layer contains all permits or completed construction. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: City of Mississauga. Licence: The City of Mississauga Terms of Use. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
